title: Restriction on use of enhanced coverage

entities.name: Registration procedure
entities.description: Procedure where UE registers with the network and receives configuration parameters including enhanced coverage restrictions.

entities.name: Generic UE configuration update procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by AMF to update UE configuration parameters including enhanced coverage restrictions.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message sent by UE to initiate registration and indicate support for restriction on use of enhanced coverage.

entities.name: REGISTRATION ACCEPT
entities.description: NAS message sent by AMF to accept registration and indicate enhanced coverage restrictions.

entities.name: Restriction on use of enhanced coverage support
entities.description: IE indicating UE support for restriction on use of enhanced coverage.

entities.name: Enhanced coverage restriction indication
entities.description: IE indicating whether enhanced coverage, CE mode A, or CE mode B is restricted for the UE.

entities.name: 5GMM-CONNECTED
entities.description: 5GMM state where UE has an established NAS signalling connection.

entities.name: No ongoing registration procedure
entities.description: Condition that there is no registration procedure currently in progress.

entities.name: Enhanced coverage restricted
entities.description: Property indicating UE is not allowed to use enhanced coverage in registered PLMN and equivalent PLMNs.

entities.name: Extended NAS timer setting
entities.description: Property indicating NAS timer values calculated for enhanced coverage scenarios.

relations.description: REGISTRATION REQUEST message contains IE indicating UE support for restriction on use of enhanced coverage.
REGISTRATION ACCEPT message contains IE indicating enhanced coverage restrictions for the UE.
Generic UE configuration update procedure requires UE to be in 5GMM-CONNECTED state.
Generic UE configuration update procedure is guarded by condition that there is no ongoing registration procedure.
Enhanced coverage restriction indication establishes whether enhanced coverage is restricted for the UE.
Enhanced coverage restriction indication establishes whether extended NAS timer settings apply.
